verses.1: For all this I have given it to my heart. And I understand all this. The righteous and the wise, and those who serve them in the hands of God… They know everything before anyone else.
verses.2: Everything happens because one person acts in a good way towards the righteous and in a bad way towards the wicked. It happens because some people are good, while others are evil. It also happens because some people are honorable, while others are not. And it happens because those who are not honorable still try to appear honorable.
verses.3: This is evil in everything that happens under the sun. It’s like one person causing harm to everyone else. And also, human hearts are full of evil and hatred. They curse each other throughout their lives, and after death, they continue to suffer.
verses.4: For those who are able to communicate with all living things, there is safety in that. It’s better for a living dog to go to heaven than for a dead lion.
verses.5: For the living know that they will die, and the dead do not know anything. They have no reward in life, since their memories are forgotten.
verses.6: Their love, their hatred, and their jealousy have also long been lost. They no longer have any share in everything that has happened under the sun.
verses.7: Go and eat with joy, your own bread. Drink from your good wine, for God has long desired your actions.
verses.8: At all times, there shall be flowers and honey on your head; none of these should be missing.
verses.9: See, there are living beings with a woman whom you loved throughout all the days of your life. He gave you everything under the sun during those days. For he was part of your life and your efforts, as you worked under the sun.
verses.10: All that you can do with your hands, do it. For there is no need for any other actions, thoughts, or wisdom in what you are doing right now.
verses.11: I sat down and saw under the sun that neither the poor who were exiled, nor the nobles who fought in battles, nor the wise men, nor the rich, nor the clever ones, nor those who knew everything, would have any kindness or favor. For at that time, all of them would suffer harm.
verses.12: For even the human being cannot know his own time, just as those who are trapped in bad situations and those who are held in a tight grip become difficult for people to deal with during times of trouble.
verses.13: Also, I saw wisdom under the sun. It was truly great.
verses.14: It’s a small city, and there are only a few people living there. There’s a great king who rules over it. He built magnificent walls around the city.
verses.15: And he found in her a wise and intelligent man. He ruled the city with his wisdom. No one remembered the wise man who had saved the city.
verses.16: And I said, “I am good and wise from a great distance. My wisdom is beyond measure, and my words are not heard.”
verses.17: The words of the wise are heard with respect, out of the cries of those who are foolish.
verses.18: Better is wisdom than all kinds of sacrifices and evil deeds. One evil act destroys much good.
